embeddings.body: { text } (exactly one input per call; a batch is fanned out sequentially in input order)
embeddings.response: { status: { code: "20000", message }, result: { embedding: number[1024], inputTokens } }; any other status code is a failure even on HTTP 200

supportedInput.input: string or 1..64 non-empty strings, each at most 20000 characters
supportedInput.dimensions: absent, null or the number 1024 (never forwarded)

accounting.success: mediaAccounting over the summed inputTokens; cost unknown; nativeUnits { inputs, calls }; meta.usageMissing when any call omitted inputTokens
accounting.acceptedJob: jobState submit-unknown (timeout, abort after send, 5xx, foreign redirect), completed-unusable (2xx with non-20000 status or bad vector), accepted (abort during body read) or partial (a definite failure after earlier calls succeeded); meta carries completedInputs and requestedInputs
